messages.content: There's clear screen burn-in on this iPad - looks like a notification bar was left on screen too long.
I've never seen burn-in on this device. Are you viewing a gray test image? Sometimes image retention can look like burn-in but goes away.
I've left it off for hours and it's still there. Also the battery is 91%, not 96% as listed.
Battery readings can vary by 2-3% depending on calibration and iOS version. That's within normal variance. Can we video call so you can show me the burn-in?
